since.description: include items created at or after WHEN

max-chars.description: maximum code points in the response (default 6000 for the body, 2000 with --history, 2000 with --outline). Project configuration can change the default.

personal.description: Include the personal section, which Git ignores. Without it personal items do not exist for this call. Set it only for the person's own request, and keep what it returns out of shared items and outside services.

tools.title: add a first-party item
tools.description: Add a decision, learning, observation or note. Supply a title and use body or body-file for its text. Name replaced items with replaces. --body cannot be used with --body-file. --body-file requires a nonempty path. a decision requires --decided and refuses --verified. --decided is only for a decision. --shared cannot be used with --personal.
